import json,statistics,sys,timeit
from beartype import beartype
from bearshape import N,DtypeSpec,make_array_type
from bearshape._dtypes import extract_dtype_str
class Array:
 shape=(3,)
 dtype='float32'
F32=make_array_type(Array,DtypeSpec('Float32',frozenset({'float32'})))
@beartype
def checked(value:F32[N])->F32[N]:return value
array=Array()
checked(array)
assert 'numpy' not in sys.modules
results=[]
for name,statement in [('custom-extract','extract_dtype_str(array)'),('custom-strict','checked(array)')]:
 samples=[t*1e6/20000 for t in timeit.repeat(statement,globals=globals(),number=20000,repeat=9)]
 results.append({'case':name,'samples_us':samples,'median_us':statistics.median(samples)})
assert 'numpy' not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'calls':20000,'repeats':9,'results':results},indent=2))

import json,statistics,timeit,sys
from weakref import WeakKeyDictionary, WeakSet
class Plain: pass
weak_map=WeakKeyDictionary({Plain:None})
weak_set=WeakSet([Plain])
cases={
 'current_getattr':"getattr(Plain, '__beartype_state__', None)",
 'weak_map_get':"weak_map.get(Plain)",
 'guarded_weak_set':"type(Plain) is type and Plain in weak_set",
}
results=[]
for name,statement in cases.items():
 samples=[t*1000 for t in timeit.repeat(statement,globals=globals(),number=1000000,repeat=9)]
 results.append({'case':name,'samples_ns':samples,'median_ns':statistics.median(samples)})
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'calls':1000000,'repeats':9,'statements':cases,'results':results},indent=2))
